Kentucky once required creationism to be taught alongside evolution and more recently replaced the term "evolution" with "change over time." However, in 2013, the state adopted the Next Generation Science Standards, which require the teaching of evolution and treat creationism…

A 1981 Louisiana law required creationism to be taught alongside evolution. That requirement was declared unconstitutional in 1987, though "academic freedom" loopholes persist that could enable teachers to insert creationism-based teachings.
